description: This file defines data models, interfaces, constants, and functions related to the configuration and rendering of an Aggregated Value Card widget in a dashboard application, including settings, positioning, and data retrieval methods.

methods.name: computeAggregatedCardValue
methods.description: Computes and returns the aggregated value card data for a specific key and position, using dependency injection for unit conversion and formatting.

methods.name: getTsValueByLatestDataKey
methods.description: Retrieves the latest data entry for a specific data key from an array of data sources.
